transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we need to discuss the hot-work repair for Resin Dryer 2's cracked access-panel hinge. As Safety Officer, I'm responsible for issuing the binding decision on whether this repair may proceed. Before I can authorize anything, we need to complete the documented pre-job review, since the dryer is adjacent to the active compounding area. That review requires current findings and sign-off from maintenance, environmental health and safety, production planning, and quality. I'd like to hear from each of you on where we stand with those required inputs.
